svg.title: Motor encoder: it counts the motor's turns
svg.desc: Animated. A steering motor, seen end-on, with its encoder inside, drives a steering module through a gearbox. As the module turns a quarter turn and back, the motor spins many times, and a row of boxes counts the motor's turns one by one, while the module's own turn fills only part of one box. The sensor inside the steering motor counts the motor's turns, not the module's. Quick and fine, but it only knows how far it turned since power-on. YAGSL's steering loop uses it, set from the absolute encoder at boot.
svg.text: Motor encoder: it counts the motor's turns
The sensor inside the steering motor: the motor spins many times per module turn.
Quick and fine, but it only knows how far it turned since power-on.
YAGSL's steering loop uses it, set from the absolute encoder at boot.
